title: Monomial bialgebras：transitive-CYBE Conjecture 1.4 的 \(n=5\)
summary: The requested n=5 conjecture is proved, in fact uniformly for every n>=1, by an exact component identity. Two novelty passes, exact enumeration, independent no-import verification, corruption tests, a separate exact sl2 breaker, proof/citation audits, a clean LaTeX build, and page-by-page PDF inspection all passed.
author: Zijian Zeng
affiliation: Institute of Computer Science and Digital Innovation, UCSI University, Kuala Lumpur, 56000, MALAYSIA
